basic_details.job_title: CSIR-CGCRI Project Assistant II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute (CSIR-CGCRI) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant - II post on a project-based engagement in Kolkata. The position offers a pay of Rs. 20,000 + HRA and is initially for 1 year, extendable up to 24 November 2027. Applicants must hold a B.Sc. in Physics or Electronics, or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering or Technology in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical or Equivalent with a minimum 60% marks/GPA, while candidates with results awaited are not eligible. Interested candidates can apply by email by sending the duly filled application for

how_to_apply: Download or obtain the prescribed application form from the notification.
Fill out the application form thoroughly in typed format (not hand-written).
Scan the completed application form along with soft copies of all self-attested supporting documents, certificates, and reprints.
Send the soft copy of the documents via email to the designated email ID: [email protected] on or before 01/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CGCRI Project Assistant - II at a Glance

rows.details: Development of YB-fiber Laser Source at 1 um
Initially for 1 year and extendable upto 24.11.2027 based on the availability of fund
Rs. 20,000/- + HRA (Increment of 15% for 3 years of experience in the same project)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements prescribed for the Project Assistant - II position.

rows.essential_qualification: B.Sc. (Physics / Electronics) or 3 years Diploma in Engineering / Technology in Electronics or Electrical or Mechanical or Equivalent with minimum 60% marks/GPA. Candidates with results awaited will not be eligible.
rows.desirable: Experience in electrical, electronics or machine handling. Proficient in basic computer skills, word, power-point etc. Lab skills in optics/fiber optics/ optomechanics and electrical wire handling/ shouldering.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position carries a stipend of Rs. 20,000/- per month plus HRA. An increment of 15% is applicable for every 3 years of experience in the same project. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-CGCRI Project Assistant - II
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the prescribed application form from the notification. Fill out the application form thoroughly in typed format (not hand-written). Scan the completed application form along with soft copies of all self-attested supporting documents, certificates, and reprints. Send the soft copy of the documents via email to the designated email ID: [email protected] on or before 01/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be called for an interview conducted through hybrid mode (offline as well as online). Candidates attending the interview online are requested to inform at the time of application. Candidates appearing for the interview in offline mode must bring original marksheets, certificates, age and caste proofs for verification, along with self-attested copies of all documents and project thesis (if any), and report at least one hour before the scheduled time.

faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application via email is 01/11/2026.

faq.question: Q2. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 03/11/2026 at 11:00 a.m. in hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit and who gets relaxation?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is up to 5 years for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped and Female candidates, and 3 years for OBCs (Non-Creamy layer candidates).
